title: Common providers: Hungary
coverage: Complete for the three national operators (fixed and mobile) and the two network companies behind them, after the mergers of 2025; regional cable operators and business ISPs are partial.
missing: Smaller regional cable operators and business ISPs
The state network operator MVM NET (no AS number found, and its address did not answer)
Websites of KIFÜ and PR-TELECOM (neither answered an automated check)
AS8990 and AS20568 (former Antenna Hungária numbers, registered to a 4iG holding company)

sources.name: NMHH (National Media and Infocommunications Authority): registers
sources.terms: The page was requested on the read date; its reuse terms were not read (they are in the national language), so nothing is copied.
sources.result: The page answered on the read date. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in Hungary
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 2 of 9 entries were found on the page, by their name or a distinctive other name.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 7 of 9 websites answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty (KIFÜ, PR-TELECOM). No support or status page was checked.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 11 AS numbers confirmed, each announced on the read date; a number whose holder was another company is listed only where the note says whose it is.

sources.name: RIPE Database (RIPE NCC): organisation and aut-num objects
sources.terms: The RIPE Database terms were not re-read for this pack; it is treated like RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to find which AS numbers an organisation holds.
sources.result: Read to find candidate AS numbers; each was then confirmed as above.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: 4iG: announcement of 1 October 2025 on 2Connect
sources.terms: Cited for a date and names (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: Found by a web search on the date above: from 1 October 2025 the networks of One, DIGI, Invitech and Antenna Hungária are in 2Connect and retail service is One Magyarország.

sources.name: Wikipedia: One Hungary; Yettel Hungary; CETIN
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Cited for dates and names (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: Read on the date above: Vodafone Hungary became One on 1 January 2025; Yettel was Telenor and Pannon; the network of Yettel was split off into CETIN Hungary.

providers.name: One Magyarország
providers.notes: Fixed and mobile. Vodafone Hungary until 1 January 2025; took in DIGI and Invitech in 2025. Its network is 2Connect's.

providers.name: Yettel Magyarország
providers.notes: Mobile. Its network is CETIN Hungary's.

providers.name: 2Connect
providers.notes: Network company of the 4iG group since 1 October 2025; One is its retail name. AS20845 carries the AS name DIGICABLE.

providers.name: CETIN Hungary
providers.notes: The network company behind Yettel; wholesale.

providers.name: KIFÜ
providers.notes: The national research and education network (HBONE).
